request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Use the input only as a premium tactile style reference. Completely redesign the Buki first screen around a subtle bear-trail brand language without showing a large mascot. Write exact text "Buki" in chunky friendly letters; shape the two counters in the capital B like tiny rounded bear ears, tasteful and abstract. Replace the old line and flower with a short path of three tiny embossed paw dots that curves into a modern paw-rosette mark: one large rounded pad and four colorful pebble toes arranged like a bloom. Recompose the blank portrait sketchpad as a warm honey-colored soft cover with a cream layered page, top disc binding, precise dot grid, generous inner frame, a small paw bookmark and one side tab. Keep the header compact and give the pad more visual prominence. Palette: honey #F2A93B, coral #F06B55, deep teal #087B78, denim #4F79C7, leaf #6FA760, cream #FFF6E7. Camera button is an understated teal charm below the pad. Premium clay-and-paper, warm, modern, child-friendly, feasible in Expo/Skia. Page blank. Exact text only "Buki". No extra words, no giant bear, no phone frame, no room or product scene.
